claims: The 2026 NFL Draft takes place from Thursday, April 23, through Saturday, April 25, 2026.
The 2026 NFL Draft takes place in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.
The first round of the 2026 NFL Draft kicks off at 8 p.m. ET on Thursday, April 23.
Rounds 2-3 of the 2026 NFL Draft take place on Friday, April 24, at 7 p.m. ET.
Rounds 4-7 of the 2026 NFL Draft take place on Saturday, April 25, at Noon ET.
Coverage of the 2026 NFL Draft is available on ABC, ESPN, and NFL Network.
TV channels for the 2026 NFL Draft include ESPN, ABC, NFL Network, ESPN Deportes, and ESPN Radio.
Streaming options for the 2026 NFL Draft include NFL+, Disney+, and Hulu.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held on the North Shore of Pittsburgh.
The 2026 NFL Draft is held near Acrisure Stadium.
The 2026 NFL Draft can be attended for free by registering on the NFL OnePass App.
